notes: No breadboard is used; the servo's 3-pin female connector is wired straight to the Uno header with jumper wires (the circuit image draws the servo leads as continuous wires).
The catalogue 'servo' entry lists no ports, so I used PWR, GND and SIG, matching the manual's wire names (PWR red, GND black, Signal white/yellow).
The image shows the black wire on a GND pin beside 5V in the power header; I used GND.1.
Signal goes to digital pin 9, as in the image and the Sweep sketch (myservo.attach(9)). The manual says other boards may need a different pin.
The USB cable for programming the Uno is not drawn in the circuit image, so it is not included.
